cases.description: Idiomatski izraz preveden nepovezanim izrazom.

segment.source: Now I know that its real object was to keep from my ears the idle tales of the dread curse upon our line, told and magnified night by night by the simple peasantry as they conversed in hushed accents in the glow of their cottage hearths.
segment.target: Sada znam da je njegov pravi cilj bio sakriti od mojih ušiju prazne puške o strašnom prokletstvu nad našom lozom, koje su svake noći pričali i uvećavali jednostavni stanari dok su tiho razgovarali u sjaju svojih grijalica.

cases.description: Arhivski dokumenti ili spisi pogrešno prevedeni kao suvremene dnevne novine.

segment.source: The papers carried me back to the days of the thirteenth century, when the old castle in which I sat was a fear-inspiring and impregnable fortress.
segment.target: Dnevne novine su me vratile u dane trinaestog stoljeća, kada je stari dvorac u kojem sam sjedio bio strašna i neosvojiva tvrđava.

cases.description: Metafora za tminu ili mrak prevedena je doslovno kao pisaća tinta.

segment.source: he vanished behind the ink of night.

cases.description: Tradicionalno pokrivalo za glavu (kalota) pogrešno prevedeno kao rekvizit za kupanje.

segment.source: He was a man clad in a skull-cap and long mediaeval tunic of dark colour.
segment.target: Bio je to čovjek odjeven u kapu za kupanje i dugu srednjovjekovnu tuniku tamne boje.

cases.description: Ubacivanje cijelog stranog idioma u tekst u kojem se nalazi samo jedna riječ.

segment.source: the mind, recalling what had occurred, shrank from the thought of seeing more; yet curiosity overcame all.

segment.source: yet what little knowledge I was enabled to gain seemed to dishearten me greatly.

segment.source: There was a rumour of a certain old man who had once lived on our estates
